messages.en:
{01 00 00 0a 00}{07 1b 00}{01 00 00 05 00}Hee hee!{01 00 00 0a 00} Well, I put his
name out of my head a
long time ago, {01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}.
messages.et:
{01 00 00 0a 00}{07 1b 00}{01 00 00 05 00}Hihii!{01 00 00 0a 00} Noh, ma viskasin
ta nime peast juba
ammu välja, {01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}.

messages.en:
{07 04 00}What? {01 00 00 0a 00}WHAT?!{01 00 00 0a 00} What's that
look for?{01 01 00} {07 06 00}This is really
important, {01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}!

{07 00 00}I'll bet that, like you, that
kid didn't have a lot
growing up. {01 00 00 0a 00}Not me, though!
{01 00 00 0a 00}{07 1b 00}{01 00 00 05 00}You know, if we didn't
live in the same town, we'd
probably never have met.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Vean kihla, et sel lapsel
polnud nagu sinulgi
kasvades palju. {01 00 00 0a 00}Mul küll oli!
{01 00 00 0a 00}{07 1b 00}{01 00 00 05 00}Tead, kui me ei elaks
samas linnas, poleks me
vist kunagi kohtunud.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.

messages.en:
{07 00 00}I noticed that that house
gained a level.{01 01 00} {07 0b 00}{01 00 00 05 00}Is the
resident a friend of yours?
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Märkasin, et see maja
sai taseme juurde.{01 01 00} {07 0b 00}{01 00 00 05 00}Kas
elanik on sinu sõber?

messages.en:
{07 00 00}{01 00 00 0a 00}Yeah, that kid lives in this
HUGE house! It's really
awesome, {04 02 00}.
{07 0d 00}If I were you, {01 00 00 0a 00}I would
definitely be extra
friendly!
messages.et:
{07 00 00}{01 00 00 0a 00}Jah, see laps elab TOHUTUS
majas! See on tõesti
vinge, {04 02 00}.
{07 0d 00}Sinu asemel {01 00 00 0a 00}oleksin ma
kindlasti eriti
sõbralik!

messages.en:
{07 1c 00}{01 00 00 0a 00}There are, like, NO people
in this town {01 00 00 0a 00}and, like, ZERO

{07 06 00}At this rate,{01 00 00 05 00} how am I
supposed to meet the man
of my dreams, {01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 0e 00}{01 00 00 0a 00}I mean, with so many people,
you'd think I'd meet one or
two, right?
{07 15 00}Every time I hear something
about your town,{01 00 00 05 00} I{01 00 00 0a 00} just get
so jealous!
messages.et:
{07 0e 00}{01 00 00 0a 00}Nii paljude inimestega
võiks arvata, et kohtan
ühte või kahte, eks?
{07 15 00}Iga kord, kui kuulen midagi
sinu linna kohta,{01 00 00 05 00} muutun{01 00 00 0a 00}
nii kadedaks!
